finance_puzzle.question: A company has Revenue = ₹1200 Cr, EBITDA margin = 15%, Debt = ₹300 Cr, Interest rate = 8%. What happens to profit (before tax) if revenue falls 10%?
finance_puzzle.answer:
Old EBITDA = ₹180 Cr → Profit before interest cost of ₹24 Cr = ₹156 Cr.
New revenue = ₹1080 Cr → New EBITDA = ₹162 Cr → New profit before tax = ₹138 Cr.
That's a change of ₹-18 Cr — notice how a 10% revenue fall swings profit by a much bigger percentage. That's operating leverage.
